voices.text: I run a real-estate brokerage in Dubai. What's the mistake costing brokers the most right now?
In the first half of 2025, the Ministry of Economy found one thousand and sixty-three money-laundering compliance violations.
Four hundred and ninety-five of them were real-estate brokerages.
Eighteen and a half million dirhams in fines. In six months.
And it's not new. In early 2023, brokerages were already a quarter of all violations.
But we're not a bank. Why brokers?
Because property is where big money moves fast. The Ministry classes real-estate agents as high-risk.
And inspectors don't ask what you meant to do. They check your due diligence, your risk assessment, and how you report suspicious transactions.
So where does the proof live?
A lot of it lives in your books. Every payment in, tied to a named client and a deal. If that trail lives in a spreadsheet, it's a guess.
RAMZA matches every incoming payment to its client and invoice, so the trail is ready before anyone asks. Your compliance officer still files the reports.
Free setup on your own transactions. Comment TRAIL.
